It is Ocean Superhero dress up day.
“Look at me,” says Jerry. “I am Super Shark.”
“Look at me,” says Kavi. “I am The Claw.”
“Look at me,” says Ana. “I am Spike.”
The classroom door opens. Masi walks in.
Everyone stares at him. “Look at you,” says Super Shark. “You are not a superhero,” says The Claw.
“You are a tree,” says Spike. Everyone laughs.
“I am a mangrove tree,” says Masi. “And I am a superhero.”
"No, you are not,” says Super Shark. “You do not look like one,” says The Claw. “Mangroves are not superheroes,” says Spike.
“I think they are,” says Masi. “They are home to the small.” “They protect the helpless.”
“And they stand up to bullies, like the sea and the wind.”
Masi and his friends start a club called The Mangrove Warriors. They help protect the environment by planting mangroves. Why don’t you become a Mangrove Warrior too?
